==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Danhua:''' Come one, come all... That's the phrase I learned from foreign customers. What do you think?
:{{DIcon}} I want some Souvenirs.
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Danhua:''' Excuse me, would you mind lending me a hand...
::{{DIcon}} What is it?
:::'''Danhua:''' Hehe, it's nothing really, just that Hongzhen has gotten a lot busier now that it's easier to come to Mt. Firmament.
:::'''Danhua:''' But my bussiness is still the same as always, neither good nor bad. Most of my customers are regulars from the town.
:::'''Danhua:''' The visitors just come in, browse, and leave without buying anything.
:::'''Danhua:''' So I thought maybe I should get something new in, stuff I've never sold before.
:::{{DIcon}} Are you looking for advice from me?
:::'''Danhua:''' Yes. You're not from here, so you probably their preferences more than I do. So please, give me some suggestions.
:::{{DIcon}} Daily necessities from Jinzhou
::::'''Danhua:''' That makes sense. People from other parts of Jinzhou aren't used to our stuff, anyway.
::::'''Danhua:''' Besides... if I could bring in some goods from Jinzhou, the regulars here in Hongzhen could also try something new.
::::'''Danhua:''' Thanks a lot. You've been a great help.
:::{{DIcon}} Local specialty of Mt. Firmament
::::'''Danhua:''' True, the things we're used to seeing in Mt. Firmament might be interesting to outsiders.
::::'''Danhua:''' Thanks a lot. You've been a great help.
:::{{DIcon}} Hand-crafted souvenirs
::::'''Danhua:''' Not a bad idea. Artisans aren't in short supply here. Throw some local flair on the souvenirs and they should sell like hotcakes.
::::'''Danhua:''' Thanks a lot. You've been a great help.
::{{DIcon}} Sorry, but I don't have the time.
::'''Danhua:''' You're busy? Sigh. It's okay, then.
::'''Danhua:''' Feel free to look around. Let me know if you see anything you like.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
